claim.statement: relish apply takes Kubernetes YAML directly (file or https URL under 1 MiB, 30 s) and converts eleven kinds in memory - Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap, Secret, Job, CronJob, HorizontalPodAutoscaler and Namespace.

sources.quote: Eleven kinds: Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap,

claim.measurable: Apply examples/kubernetes/podinfo.yaml and https://reliaburger.com/demo/podinfo.yaml; a Deployment+Service+Ingress+HPA with matching names becomes one [app.NAME]; DaemonSet gets replicas = "*"; a file is treated as Kubernetes only if it has apiVersion and kind lines; http:// URLs, responses over 1 MiB or slower than 30 s are refused; --dry-run applies nothing; the report goes to stderr before apply.
